title: Meridian
subtitle: This exceptional pendant centers a fancy intense yellow round brilliant diamond, set in yellow gold prongs and encircled by a close-set halo of colorless round diamonds. Radiating outward, a full ring of tapered baguettes forms a sunburst around the center.
